env_vars.name: TARES_FACTORY_SOURCE

env_vars.name: TARES_FACTORY_TOKEN_FILE

env_vars.name: TARES_FACTORY_URL
env_vars.what: the Tares address stations are given; written to station settings and by tares/cli.py

state_files.name: crew.json
state_files.what: crew config: human, authorization, crew_name, models, release
state_files.note: Merged with templates/crew.json defaults on every command.

state_files.name: stations.json
state_files.what: one record per station: id, session, cwd, settings, grants

state_files.name: events.jsonl
state_files.what: append-only event log

state_files.name: HALT
state_files.what: present while the crew is halted; holds the reason
state_files.note: guard.sh and session-start.sh read it (TR-971, TR-972).

state_files.name: frozen-kit
state_files.what: folder: copy of the kit while frozen

state_files.name: kit-newer
state_files.what: the newer kit the watch last told the person about

state_files.name: freezing
state_files.what: present while a freeze has the copy but Tares not yet the setting
state_files.note: Counts as fresh for five minutes.

state_files.name: claude-newer
state_files.what: the newer Claude Code the watch last told the person about while frozen

state_files.name: kit-checkout
state_files.what: the checkout the frozen copy was taken from

state_files.name: .tares-token
state_files.what: the person's key copied for the stations (mode 600)
state_files.note: The key stays a 0600 file (owner-only ACL on Windows) for stations; the OS keychain holds the person's login key (TR-949), stations never read it.

state_files.name: pace.json
state_files.what: crew-wide pace state: stopped, tried, limit_since, said
state_files.note: Written whole through a temp file.

state_files.name: watch.pid
state_files.what: pid of the background watch
state_files.note: TR-958 also owns the stop file idea for a portable stop (no signals on Windows).

state_files.name: watch.log
state_files.what: output of the background watch

state_files.name: stations
state_files.what: folder of per-station files

state_files.name: stations/*.settings.json
state_files.what: the settings file a station launches with

state_files.name: stations/*.lock
state_files.what: mkdir lock holding pid; one starts or stops a station at a time
state_files.note: A takeover sibling folder <station>.lock.takeover guards stale clearing.

state_files.name: stations/*.done
state_files.what: marks a builder finished so the watch leaves it stopped
state_files.note: Created by a builder's own session: claude-plugin/skills/station-builder/SKILL.md runs touch on it (TR-974 makes that safe in Git Bash). factory removes it at spawn and reads it.

state_files.name: stations/*.pace
state_files.what: what the pace told a station: stretched, held

state_files.name: stations/*.wake
state_files.what: a station's idle wake state

state_files.name: stations/*.grants
state_files.what: the grants text a station started with, to say what changed

state_files.name: reports
state_files.what: folder of station reports (<crew>-orchestrator.md)
state_files.note: Written by the stations; the idle wake reads the orchestrator's RELEASE lines (TR-961).

state_files.name: worktrees
state_files.what: worktrees for stations without a repo

state_files.name: tmp
state_files.what: scratch folder that tidy may remove inside

state_files.name: templates/crew.json
state_files.what: template of crew.json defaults

state_files.name: plugin.json
state_files.what: plugin version, part of the kit fingerprint

state_files.name: ~/.claude.json
state_files.what: Claude Code's record of trusted folders
state_files.note: Read by home_trusted (TR-956), trusted (TR-966) and doctor (TR-969).

state_files.name: ~/.claude/jobs/<id>/state.json
state_files.what: Claude Code's state of a background session
state_files.note: Includes respawnFlags, which doctor checks for cmux shim leftovers.

state_files.name: ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json
state_files.what: installed Claude Code plugins
state_files.note: Read for a clashing tares plugin and by lsp_read_plugins (TR-970).

state_files.name: ~/.claude/projects/*/<session>.jsonl
state_files.what: a session's transcript

state_files.name: ~/.config/cmux/cmux.json
state_files.what: cmux settings (JSONC); doctor reads agentIdleReminder, never edits

state_files.name: ~/.tares/login.json
state_files.what: the key and cell URL `tares login` saved
state_files.note: Since TR-949 tares login can keep the key in the OS keychain (opt-in with TARES_KEYRING=on) and login.json then keeps only the non-secret fields. Off by default: doctor, mcp-headers (TR-972) and ship.py still read .key from the file, so the default flips only when they read the keychain.

state_files.name: tares-factory-heavy.lock
state_files.what: machine-wide lock folder of factory-heavy (pid, what)

cmux_touchpoints.name: claude_bin skips cmux shims (check)
cmux_touchpoints.what: skip a claude that is a script mentioning cmux
cmux_touchpoints.note: Mac only in practice; Windows has no cmux, but the real-binary search still needs to run there.

cmux_touchpoints.name: idle reminder comment
cmux_touchpoints.match: cmux shows its own|notice, and cmux reads
cmux_touchpoints.what: why doctor reads cmux's idle reminder

cmux_touchpoints.name: doctor respawnFlags check
cmux_touchpoints.what: a station started through the cmux shim keeps a temp settings file in its respawn flags; doctor flags it

cmux_touchpoints.name: crew_test cmux cases
cmux_touchpoints.what: doctor cmux cases, plus a check that station settings do not disable cmux hooks (CMUX_CLAUDE_HOOKS_DISABLED)
cmux_touchpoints.note: The settings check belongs to TR-953: the Python write_settings must not set that variable.
